segments.text: So in other words, aside from the sin tax collection, wala pong additional from the national government. Kasi mandated naman po ito ng batas eh. Ano po, tama. For the information of the Secretary, last budget hearing,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: nagkwentahan po kami on the floor exactly magkano ang kakulangan ng national government sa PhilHealth, sa share ng sin taxes. In the proper time, Mr. Chair, sa proper time, magkikwentahan po ulit tayo, Secretary. Thank you. Moving

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: on to the next question. Para naman po ulit ito sa...

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Sorry ha, nawala.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: My next question would be for the DBM na lang ulit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: The DBCC itself admitted that corruption heavily impacted on our economic growth. So, aside from nabanggit niyo po earlier on

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: infrastructure projects na gaginawanin niyong bago katulad ng

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: pagsisiguro na complete, may readiness yung project, complete yung documents, what other reforms have the DBM instituted para hindi po maulit ang mga korupsyon at mga wastage ng public funds na nangyari in the past several years?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Mr. Chair, your honor, bukod po doon sa mas  masusing pagsusuri po na ginawa natin sa mga proposal which is primary reform po na masasabi natin. Dahil doon pa lang po

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: masisiguro natin na hindi,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: maiiwasan na maging ghost projects po.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Marami pa pong mga nakaabang na reform kapagka nagsimula na po tayong mag

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: -implement. So, kasama na po dyan yung early procurement. Dahil isa po sa naging

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: suliranin natin ngayon ay dahil late po na-implement yung mga infrastructure projects, naka-apekto po ito. Sa ating economic activities during the first half.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: During the procurement po, hindi lang po early procurement,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: sa ilalim po ng new government procurement act, mas bukas po yung ating mga

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: procurement activities. Kasama po dyan yung pag-livestream ng ating mga

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: procurement activities, pagpo-post po ng lahat ng detalye ng ating mga procurement upang mas masubaybayan po ng ating mga kababayan at ng ating mga kasama, even sa civil society. Lahat

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: po ng ating mga procurement activities. In terms of transparency, Your Honor,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: tayo po sa DBM ay

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: patuloy po natin ginagawa yung agency performance review.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Inulunsa din po natin yung DBM Compass, which you can access po at compass.dbm.gov.ph kung saan masusubaybayan po natin ang

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: bawat isang release ng allotment.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Ito po ay

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: isusupplement naman ng tinatawag naming project dime, kung

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: saan hindi lamang po kami magre-rely on documentary submission na accomplishment report,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: lalo na po sa ating mga infrastructure projects. Gagamit po tayo ng teknolohiya,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: satellite imagery, upang ma-validate kung yung talaga pong na-report ay accomplished, ay talaga pong nagawa at nakikita sa ating mga satellite images, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Maraming salamat po. That leads me to my next question.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Para sa DepDev dito, because in your handouts, sa handout po ng DepDev you

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: made the listing of the priority bills that you want Congress to support or pass with regard to corruption and transparency and governance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Curiously po, hindi po nakapaloob doon, wala po doon yung Cadena Act. Hindi po ba supportive ang DepDev sa Cadena Act?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Also, I would also want to direct that question to the DBM because to my mind, yung if we are to talk about transparency, more than that, yung Cadena pa, it will ensure citizen participation. So, hindi po ba ninyo nire-recommend ang

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Cadena Act as one of your reforms na gustong isunong?

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: Mr. Chair, the list of measures that I flashed this morning, is

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: a partial list.

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: From the

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: point of view of

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: economic development, those are the ones that we believe will

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: help

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: us recover quickly.

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: But the LEDAC has a longer list of

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: over

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: 50 measures,

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: and and

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: Cadena is one of those. So, I think that we

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: continue to push for that, Mr.

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: Chair, And I think that's an important

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: measure.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Thank you, Secretary. May I now ask the Secretary of DBM? Kasi may mga nabanggit po siya kanina. I asked earlier, what reforms have have you made in the budget process this time? So, what is your take on the Cadena Act?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Mr. Chair, your honor, while we echo the statement of the Secretary of DepDev that it's still indeed in the list,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: tayo po naman, whatever modality na

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: available or technology, ay atin pong lahat pinukonsidera para lalo pong mapalakas yung transparency ng ating budget. Isa lamang din po dun sa ating consideration would be the

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: applicability of technology and access of all the government agencies. Dahil alam naman po natin,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: as an archipelagic nation, minsan lalo po kapag ka ganitong umuulan, naaapektuhan naapektuhan po yung ating signal, etc., et cetera, and internet access.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: So, we have to consider all of this,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: para po masiguro na yung mapipili po natin na final na platform would be usable, reliable, at accessible po para sa lahat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Thank you, Secretary De Leon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: My next question, madami po pa sana, Mr. Chair, pero last ko na lang po ito. For the DOF,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: in your handout also, na it ano lang po ako, it says there, yung last page

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: ng inyong handout, our national budget can work

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: harder when we invest in high multiplier programs and projects that create lasting economic value.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Can you please be specific what example or two perhaps of your proposed, in the proposed 2027 budget? Can, will really create lasting economic value?

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: Mr. Chair, Your Honor, I

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: think the specific example to your question would have to be infrastructure.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: For several reasons, infrastructure projects

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: have the highest multiplier effect,

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: meaning for every peso we spend on

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: infrastructure, there's a

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: multiplier effect of probably three to six times.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: And also, infrastructure leaves

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: a lasting

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: legacy, if you will, that can be used by future generations for a long period

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: of time.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Last na po, Mr. Chair. Halimbawa po, ano pong mga specific infrastructure projects that we have for the 2027 budget?

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: The rails, for example.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: The Metro Manila...

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: Line,

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: the north-south commuter line, and of course, numerous DPWH projects,

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: but I'm not, I wouldn't know the specifics.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: That would be all for now, Mr. Chair. Thank you.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Next to interpolate, Representative Albert Garcia.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Thank you very much, Madam Chair, and good afternoon once again to our DBCC family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Just a few questions, Madam Chair, na gusto ko lang ng konting kalinawan

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, as we all know, and based on the JICA study, we are losing 3.5 billion pesos a day.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, ngayon po, maghahapon na, just

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: like that, we lost 3.5

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: billion pesos based

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: on the study.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Because of traffic, congestion, time wasted, work-life balance compromised, pollution, and so on and so forth. So, na-measure po ito ng JICA to the tune of 3.5 billion. 3.5 billion pesos a day.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And if it's not solved or addressed by 2030, it

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: will rise up to 5.4 billion pesos a day.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, ganun po, kagrabe po ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And ang total po niyan sa isang taon is around 1.2 trillion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, I guess, Madam Chair, yun na po yung pinag-uusapan nating capital outlay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Kasi yung PS, hindi na naman natin pwedeng galawin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, with MOE.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, ito na po lahat na negate lang nitong losses per day.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And to date, just to give you a context,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: in-add po natin to date, ang nawala na po sa ating ekonomiya is 13.7 trillion pesos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Double our existing national

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: budget. Ganun po, kagrabe.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And since kayo... Kayo po yung economic managers, I want to ask, what are we doing to address this? Nang sa ganun, ay hindi na umabot ng 5.4 billion pesos a day.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Madam Chair, Your Honor, parahin malaking bahagi po nung loss na yun ay productivity loss due to, of course, as we know, traffic in

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: rapidly urbanizing areas. Kaya naman po, kung papansin po natin sa ating National Expenditure Program, talagang priority po yung investment natin for

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: more available transportation options para sa ating mga kababayan,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: mass transportation options para sa mga urbanizing area,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: urban and urbanizing area, hindi lamang po sa NCR, kundi maging po sa mga karatig region, gayon din po may investment din tayo for mass transportation sa Visayas and Mindanao. So, ito rin naman po ang direktiba ng Presidente na masiguro na matapos,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: na

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: practical yung mga

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: proyektong ito upang agad pong mapakinabangan ng mga kababayan natin at makabawas po doon sa nabanggit po ng kagalang-galang na kinatawa ng mga productivity loss due to traffic, among many others, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Pero ang strategy po natin to build more in the urban area and the more we build, the more we create traffic. We build on top. We build under.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Dapat tinitignan din po natin yung periphery.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, how we can manage the traffic or the congestion even

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: better? Kasi puro linear.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: may I ask for a reply, Madam Chair?

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: May I, Mr.

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: Chair?

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: The overall plan is to improve the connectivity. So, the

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: country, both physical and digital. Connectivity meaning connecting our rapidly

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: urbanizing or highly urbanized areas to other

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: areas, particularly lagging areas of the country. And

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: that may involve mass transit as a focus, for example.

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: And

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: that will allow mobility

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: at lesser cost for both. For

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: people and the movement of goods and services.

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: So, the

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: law

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: that you just passed, which created the

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: DEPDEM, and we

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: are that agency, Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: entrusted us to coordinate the development of a long-term master plan for infrastructure, especially transport infrastructure. So, we are working closely with... our

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: transport agencies, our infrastructure agencies, like DOTR and DPWH, for

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: the development of that long-term master plan for

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: infrastructure.

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Just for a suggestion, aside from building

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: linear north-south, let's also consider east-west para off the overly beaten path, so to speak, at

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: mas ma

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: -divert

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: natin yung traffic from the overly congested

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: north and south, especially in Metro Manila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And, Madam Chair, very quickly,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: in the spirit of first principles thinking in solving a problem,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: alam po ba natin kung ano talaga ang root cause nitong problema na itong 3.5 billion pesos a day of losses?

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: Yeah, Mr. Chair. As I said, I think the

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: underdevelopment of our connectivity infrastructure is key.

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: It's so well known that we have

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: severely underinvested in infrastructure,

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: particularly mass transit.

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: So, we should have developed mass transit long ago, but we

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: preferred instead to develop...

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: highways and more roads. So,

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: I think that allowed the rapid growth of regions like NCR and prevented the

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: concentration of growth, as well as

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: hindering the development of other growth areas.

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: There is no...

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: reason why other

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: regions, other areas of the country should not grow as fast as Metro Manila if we build a proper ecosystem for these areas. So, the rapid migration to Metro Manila contributed part

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: of that problem, and then we failed to develop the mass transit that compounded the problem.

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: So, the

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: trust of our development plan, our long-term vision, as well as the PDP, is to

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: build that connectivity so that

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: growing areas, rapidly growing areas, are connected with lagging areas so that there will be more inclusive development across the country.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair. Thank you, Sec. Arsi. I think, in my humble opinion, you hit the nail right on the head.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: It is the in-country migration that is unmanaged. So,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: do

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: we have any plan to

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: manage the in-country migration, aside from growing the regions?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Because it

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: will take time to grow the regions. In the meantime, people are looking for jobs, so they go to the center, aside from growing abroad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: in the meantime that we're developing the infra, which will take a

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: lot of time, mayroon ba tayong

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: plan to manage the in-country migration that really contributed? To the 3.5 billion pesos a day?

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: I think we can start with a few areas that have so much potential for rapid

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: economic growth so that people

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: don't have to come to Metro Manila as a final

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: destination for

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: jobs. For

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: example, I

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: look at Iloilo, I look at Cebu, I look at

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: Bohol,

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: Pangasinan. There are many of those. Bataan, of course, is a high potential, especially once

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: you complete that Cavite-Bataan bridge. I

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: think Bataan will be a magnet for investment.

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: So, I think the good news, Mr. Chair, is that

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: population growth has actually come down substantially and fertility is now just 1

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: .7, I think, or

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: 1.7. 1 And.7. so, there

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: is now much less... There is less pressure for

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: migration than, say, 10 years ago because of that rapid

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: decline or population growth.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Thank you, Madam

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Chair. Thank you, Sec. Arsi. I'm looking forward to

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: those

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: plans to really control or manage the in-country migration while we're

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: growing the regions so that they don't have to go to OFW or

segments.text: it's lodged to those agencies, the OTR, the BWH. So, they pay or we pay penalties because of the long delays of our ODAs or foreign assisted projects?

segments.text: Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: yeah, I did mention earlier that I believe it would be in the implementing agencies'

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: contracts with their service providers or their contractors that might include a penalty clause if projects are delayed.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: But the more...

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: What's

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: more obvious that always happens when a project is delayed is

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: that because of the the... time element,

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: the project cost will actually go up.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: Rather than... So, in a way, you can call it a penalty, but it's really in

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: another form. It's in the form of a cost overrun or additional

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: project cost.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: So, we have witnessed that in several

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go

segments.text: Thank you, SecDec. And it would be good to know whether from DBCC or sa mga respective agencies to know the total of

segments.text: So, I

segments.text: Madam Chair, maraming salamat po. Thank you, Sec. Dec.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Next, to interpelate, Representative Percival Cendaña

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair. Good afternoon, everyone.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Madam Chair, before we discuss the details of the budget,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: I think it is important for us in Congress to understand the fiscal story behind this 7.2 trillion proposal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: The numbers before us today are materially different from

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: what DBCC presented to Congress only a year ago.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Growth expectations have been lowered.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: The projected deficit is higher.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Revenue expectations have been reduced. Interest payments have crossed 1.1 trillion. And the composition of expenditure appears to be lower.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: So,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: our job is not merely to ask whether 7.2 trillion is enough. We

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: need to ask whether the assumptions are credible, whether the priorities are correct, and whether taxpayers are receiving sufficient value for every additional peso government spends or borrows. The question Congress must answer is simple.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Given our limited fiscal space, who gets the money? What

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: are we sacrificing to finance it? And what evidence tells us that these are the right choices?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: To say that the fiscal space is narrow is an understatement. I'm sure our economic managers will share this sentiment. But that's for another set of questions. Let me begin with last

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: year, DBCC told Congress that the economy could grow by 6 to 7 percent in

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: are now projecting only 5 to 6

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: percent. What specifically changed? And I'll also throw in my follow-up question because of the limited time. How much of the downgrade is attributable to external conditions and how much reflects domestic factors such as weak investment, agricultural performance, infrastructure implementation, consumption, or government underspending?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: If growth is only 4 percent in 2027, what happens to revenue, the deficit, and the debt-to-GDP ratio?

segments.text: Compared to last year, who

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: Middle East conflict?

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: Who would have expected that global trade

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: uncertainty would

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: suddenly skyrocket because of these

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: changes

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: in tariff by the

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: U.S. government, for example?

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: And

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: all these geopolitical tensions that are happening.

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: make our growth targets realistic and our

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: approach to addressing our problems more realistic. We believe that even

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: though the growth is less next year compared to what we

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: targeted earlier,

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: this kind of growth is going to be one

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: that is enduring, meaning that

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: while

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: it's lower, we are building a stronger foundation for a faster growth

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: in the succeeding years. We can't be irresponsible by

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: trying

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: to drive high growth when the fundamentals will

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: not support it. That can lead us to even worse problems like the

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: deficit that you just mentioned, Mr.

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña

segments.text: happens to revenue, the deficit,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña

segments.text: proportionately to the reduction

segments.text: Ganun pa rin po yung kwento, no? Yung iba yung kwento last year, iba dun sa kwento this year.

segments.text: So,

segments.text: the

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: projects that were not

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: vetted during the NEP, but were included in the final GAA, Your Honor, Mr. Chair.

segments.text: is released.

segments.text: So,

segments.text: As a matter, of policy, Your Honor, a SARO is a sub-allotment advice. So, this pertains to allotment authority. And an NCA is different because that is an authority to disperse.

segments.text: for a department to issue a SARO?

segments.text: Honor.
