segments.speaker: Rep. Allan U. Ty
segments.text: Or less than 0

segments.speaker: Rep. Allan U. Ty
segments.text: .5 percent?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Based

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: on my quick calculation, Your Honor, it's about 0.4 percent, if it's correct,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: versus

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: TEP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Allan U. Ty
segments.text: Magkaiba po kami ng calculator, Your Honor. Chicheck ko lang po yung brand. Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Makaiba

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: po kami ng brand ng calculator, Your Honor. For Congress, it's just about 0.39 percent.

segments.speaker: Rep. Allan U. Ty
segments.text: How about for judiciary?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: For judiciary, it's about 0.36.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: That's about 1

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: .19 percent, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Allan U. Ty
segments.text: And the rest is for the executive branch.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Including interest payments and other

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: automatic

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: appropriations, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Allan U. Ty
segments.text: Correct, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Yes, Your Honor, Mr. Chair, the rest. But with the exception of

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: constitutional commissions, Your Honor, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Allan U. Ty
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Secretary. So, what is the approved disbursement program for fiscal year 2026?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: 2026, Your Honor, the latest DBCC-approved disbursement program is at 6.465 trillion pesos,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Mr. Chair, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Allan U. Ty
segments.text: How about for fiscal year 2027? What is the proposed disbursement program?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: For fiscal year 2027, that is 6.9 trillion pesos, Your Honor, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Allan U. Ty
segments.text: Of the FY2026 disbursement program, how much is expected to be

segments.speaker: Rep. Allan U. Ty
segments.text: used for the settlement of outstanding accounts payable?

segments.speaker: Rep. Allan U. Ty
segments.text: And how much are accounts payable?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Mr. Chair, accounts payable is actually a moving figure, including current and prior years.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: If the Honorable

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Congressman and Chair would allow, we can submit that information to the Committee on Appropriations. As we will have to validate again. Exactly. Which portion of the disbursement program will go to accounts payables?

segments.speaker: Rep. Allan U. Ty
segments.text: Mr. Secretary, can you not go over your derivation of the FY2026 cash appropriations?

segments.speaker: Rep. Allan U. Ty
segments.text: It states here that in 2026, you have around accounts payable of 1.190 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Thank you very much, Honorable T.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: That will be the last question. Secretary Kim, please reply.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Then the other will be submitted.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Honorable T, thank you.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Mr. Chair, we will do submit the details because apparently we don't have that figure right now in any of our briefing materials. But we'll definitely submit or get back to the Honorable Representative as soon as we get the information.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Is that okay with the Honorable Ty?

segments.speaker: Rep. Allan U. Ty
segments.text: Yes, and

segments.speaker: Rep. Allan U. Ty
segments.text: also for the projected disbursement program for FY2027.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: We will do, Your Honor, part of the accounts payables for 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Thank you very much.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Honorable Allan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: so

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: I'll

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: reserve for the second round.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So we go back to the majority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Tatawagin ko po yung katabi ko, si

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Chairman,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Representative Miro

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Quimbo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Please proceed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Maraming salamat. Magandang gabi, Senior

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Vice Chairman Abet and to the members of the committee,

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: as well as our resource persons.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: My question is very, very quick, very short. I'm sure everybody says that, but anyway.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Secretary Kim, congratulations on your appointment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: I've always been

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: telling my colleagues that I've worked with somebody with

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: you in the past and you're

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: certainly somebody who finds solutions instead of raising problems, which

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: I think is very, very important.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Ang

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: tanong ko is relative to underspending.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: I

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: do not know if you have the figures at least for 2025.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Would it be too premature to ask for 2026?

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: What is our underspending relative to

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: year-on-year? Or kaya na ba yun

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: makalculate?

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Kasi two years yan, di ba, ang ating effectivity?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Mr. Chair, Your Honor, the closest that we can probably get when we talk about underspending would be actual disbursement based on program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: This is for 2026, correct?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Disbursement as of June 30, Your Honor, that we can actually secure.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Can you provide me, just provide me in writing, but if you have it,

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: you have it by department or

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: in general?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: By department, Your Honor, we will submit by department actual disbursement as of end of 2025, full year, including that of...

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: mid-year of 2026 as well. We can provide that, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: What is the general figure? What do you have in terms of underspending?

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Kahit for 2025 na lang?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Full year 2025, Your Honor, Mr. Chair, the

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: program disbursement for 2025 is 6.082 trillions and

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: the actual spending is 6.030 trillion,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: about 52

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: billion

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: short from the program. Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: And for 2026, you have a mid-year figure?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: For

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: For 2026, Your Honor, our mid-year program is about 3—

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Excuse me, my

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: time is still moving. Go ahead, Secretary.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Our mid-year program for expenditure, Your Honor, is 3.176 and

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: our actual disbursement is about 3.175. So, only about 1 billion short from our program, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: How do you define spending?

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Is that obligated or

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: binayad na talaga yan?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Actual disbursement po ito, Your Honor, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: So,

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: am I accurate to say that we are practically not

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: underspending today? Tama ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: That's news to us, ha?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Based on the latest figures as of June, Your Honor, we're just 1 billion short of our programmed expenditure.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Okay. Just

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: provide us by department in writing na lang.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Yes, Your Honor, we'll provide.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: So, having said that, at least with that 1 billion that we're referring to or talking about,

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: you do recognize that underspending is a major sin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Meaning, when

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: you set aside money and it doesn't happen,

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: there are cascading effects. To us laymen, what is the effect when that happens?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Yes, Your Honor, as we have seen, of course, economic activity, we're also limited and even our growth was affected if government itself

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: was not able to spend what was appropriated.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: And plus the fact that when the projects were actually funded,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: there were other projects that were not funded as well. So, these were

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: put into sideline to prioritize these projects. So, we really would like these projects to be implemented, Your Honor, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: I state that, Secretary, because one of the reasons why there is... is

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: underspending at least for public works is

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: primarily because of a number of requirements, which today we are also facing relative

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: to the issuance of the or the NEP

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: results.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Meron kasing isa dun is yung...

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: One of the reasons why things don't get implemented is

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: the lack of support on the part of the local government.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: So, isa yun eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Pag hindi nakakuha ng building permit,

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: location plan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: ng demolition permit,

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: talagang walang magawa eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: So, today it's now a basic requirement for any new item in the budget of the DPWH. What

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: is the remedy when that happens? We have to provide a remedy when the

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: LGU itself becomes the stumbling block.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Ano bang recourse natin dyan?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: I think number one, Mr. Chair, this is insofar as actual implementation is concerned, definitely yun pong permitting is... Already after the allotment was issued,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: we are not requiring those permits prior to the release of the

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: allotment. And that is also why we put premium, Your Honor, dun po sa

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: early coordination at

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: the very beginning of the planning. And even the departments, we actually require

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: them during budget preparation. Ito pong for 2027,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: there's already this manifestation that we require from the agencies. Ito pong mga ganitong

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: coordination with the respective local... localities sa pagkuha po ng mga necessary permits, including national government,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: are actually tapos na or taken care of so that we avoid a similar occurrence for 2027, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: But what happens kung sa CDC level pa lang, hindi siya tine-take up or in-approve?

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: And that's pre-budgeting.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: So, anong recourse?

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Ibig ba sabihin, if there's a political dynamics within a local

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: government, wala nang talagang pag-asa makakuha ng pondo

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: galing sa national government? What is the

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: recourse, Secretary Kim?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Isa po kasi, Your Honor, sa kinukonsider natin is also a provision of the local government code on coordination, of course, with the local

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: government units. But definitely,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: in ideal sense, Your Honor, what we envision is dapat po aligned yung

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: development plans, both at the local level, napapanig po sa regional development plan, at kung ano man po yung pupondohan ng national government, is actually in line with

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: the requirements of the local

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: government unit. So,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: the coordination part on the part of the national government agency who will implement the project is very

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: crucial dun po sa subject matter, subject

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: project that we are discussing, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: It is crucial, but

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: is it

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: critical? Ibig ko sabihin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: what if na, Secretary, that that's a situation on the ground?

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: It's not uncommon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: because I'm speaking from my own experience.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: What is the remedy?

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Do we just

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: write? I mean, anong sumulat na kami sa

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: lahat, anti-red tape, pero wala eh. Anong remedy for development in a particular district?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: I think while prior consultation with the local government code is something that is enshrined in the

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: local government code, ito po ay mga priority. Ito po ay mga priority projects ng national government. So, I believe we really have to

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: exhaust these remedies to make sure that the projects gets implemented, kasi

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: sayang naman po yung resources allocated for these projects that will also

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: redound to benefits ng ating mga kababayan in that specific locality. Nevertheless, Your Honor, if

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: there is a specific project, then probably we can also call the attention of the anti-red tape authority, given that these are also national projects.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: We've done it, and they have been callous relative to that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Sir Kim,

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: yun lang naman ang tanong natin eh. Sa barangay, okay siya lahat, particularly for highly urbanized cities, we have no other requires higher than that authority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: If I accept that answer, then that's not local autonomy, that's local

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: authority monopoly. Hindi naman yun ang ini-envision ng batas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Because power is meant to be shared equally, because hindi naman yung isang may repository of the truth eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: So, yun ang hinihingi kung ano ang pwedeng, kung ano ang magagawa sa ganyang pagkakataon. There has to be a solution, guys.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Mr. Chair, since the project is enacted

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: in the GAA and hindi natin simply mapapalitan yung project, the other recourse that we are also top

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: of mind is we seek the intervention of the Department of Interior and Local Government,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: who has the power of supervision over the local government units, Your Honor, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Hindi yung problema kasi. Hindi natin sa CDC pa lang eh, sa

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: pre-budget eh. So, sa post, okay yun, pero yung pre, anong recourse?

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Kung hindi kami makadaan sa CDC, na hindi kami ma-agenda, paano yun?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Mr. Chair, since these are actually more internal in terms of local government operations, may we respectfully defer to the

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: DILG on other possible recourse on that particular instance?

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: I will have to seek your intervention.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Because this is a budget matter.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Whether it is putting it in the GAA itself, at least on the implementation side, saying that

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: items or permits are deemed approved, if submitted, complete within 30 days, and still there is no action, that's one recourse that we have.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: But it is the pre-budget that

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: is my source of concern, which is really plaguing us,

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: and especially with the requirements that you have come up with. Anong gagawin namin?

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Mag-aantay kami ng isang taon, dalawang taon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: bago kami magkaroon ng line item sa budget? We

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: We fully recognize that, Your Honor, especially its implications in succeeding projects for particular localities.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: localities. And we'll also check and sit down with the DILG on particular

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: recourse or actions that we can take. We'd be happy to work with Your

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Honor on this particular matter.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: I will normally never accept

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: that answer, but today I will accept it.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Because we cannot allow that

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: there is political domination. It's the defense of our district.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Hindi talaga katanggap-tanggap. Kailangan

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: mahanapin siya ng solusyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Thank you very much, SBC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Kong Miro.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And I hope DBM

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: with DILG and the representative of

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Marikina resolves this issue very, very soon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, for

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: the last representative,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: for the first round,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Marikina. Who would propound her questions, may we call on

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Congresswoman Renee Co.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Thank you, Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: First questions ko po for DBM.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Na-mention po kanina yung free higher education deficiency. And yung update din po, Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: that may 9.75 billion na nga pong released from the free higher education deficiency. So, I'm happy to hear that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: May 12 billion kasi pong na-promise. From last year's budget deliberations. Dahil may deficiency na hindi na-release to the SUCs. And na-pinpoint actually yung cause of that. May several questions po ako para ma-ensure na hindi na po ulit mangyari ito. Una po, nakalagay

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: po kasi sa RA 10931 na dapat po ang basihan ng formula ng budget ng SUC ay yung projected number of enrollees for each academic year. Since

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: 2022, nung nalipat po sa DBM yung pag-calculate ng budget neto, ang nakuha nating report ay naging based

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: po on actual number of enrollees of the previous academic year. Ito po yung naging root cause ultimately kung bakit merong 12 billion higher

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: education

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: deficiency. So, can

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: I ask the good secretary kung resolved na po ba ito? Ano po ba yung formula na gamit nyo ngayon para i-calculate? Yung budget ng SUCs.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Mr. Chair, your honor, in calculating for particularly for the 2027 level

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: for

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: the free

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: higher education, we have used the average actual enrollment including the growth over the past three years so

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: that at the very least we can apply hindi lang po yung actual but even yung projected growth based on historical

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: figure. So, this way,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: medyo mas malapit po ito. Hopefully, mas malapit po ito because you already factored in potential average growth rate.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Hindi na lang po siya yung actual as of last academic year.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: In addition, continues po, your honor, Mr. Chair, yung aming discussion with CHED and UNIFAST para po mas mai-align

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: yung programming for the universal access for quality tertiary education. In

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: fact, meron pong ongoing study on the normative formula for

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: our state universities and colleges. And meron po kaming

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: scheduled meeting this week kung hindi po makancel

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: dahil sa malakas

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: pong pag-ulan. We are scheduled to meet po with CHED, UNIFAST, and some

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: representatives of our SUCs to discuss the proposed normative financing moving forward.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Mr. Chair, Secretary, magkukompang question na rin ako dahil marami tayong gustong itanong. So, una po, actually, yung unang nirequest natin last year nung kinampanya po ito kasama yung SUC administrators and student leaders, ay 15 billion po yung FHE deficiency na isagot dahil po inaasahan natin na meron pa rin deficiency from 2025 to 2026 dahil hindi nga po nagbago yung calculation. So, can I ask po, okay, from yung 12 billion covering up to 2025,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ano po ba yung deficiency from 2025 to 2026, if any, Secretary, Mr. Chair?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And to add na lang din po, dahil noong kinokontrol, kung consult po natin yung state universities and college, they're reporting na meron pa rin. Lumiit, pero meron pa rin pong deficiency. So, syempre, we'd like to ask, paano po yun? And paano po syempre i-cover yun?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Based on latest data available to DBM, Your Honor, we don't have yet information on the supposed deficiency.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: And we stand ready and we continuously coordinate with CHED and UNIFAST so that we can secure the data so

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: that once we go back to Congress, we can at least find some solution. There's

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: funding deficiency and where we can source them in the event there's a deficiency for

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: the latest academic year, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: But that's for the latest, no? Pero meron tayong previous academic years na hindi po na-cover ng 12 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: But anyway, we have data rin po, Secretary,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Mr. Chair. We can submit that para po ma-insure na kung ano man pong kailangan may pondo ay mapondohan sa pinakakagyat. Next question po, regarding din sa operation ng SUCs. We are aware. We are aware that DBM, in a memo, required different government agencies to essentially ibalik 20% ng kanilang MOOE para po sa uplift, I assume. And ang

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ating SUCs ay nag-submit ng kanilang posesyon na sana hindi po gawin for SUCs. Kulang na kulang na nga po yung budget sa operations, matatanggalan pa rin po. May I ask DBM kung meron na po ba silang response doon? Doon sa kanilang concern.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Mr. Chair, Your Honor, we confirm that we have received that request from our SUCs for exemption from the implementation of NBC 906, 602 and 603. However, we are constrained

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: because there is no such provision for any exemption. What we clarified sa

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: atin pong mga SUCs, Your Honor, Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: is not, it's just that we are not asking for,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: 20% of their MOOE.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: The coverage of the circular is actually 20% of unobligated MOOE, which is different from 20%

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: of MOOE.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Because, of course, we don't calculate and get savings from

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: allotments already obligated. So that's two different figures. And we

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: thank, of course, those SUCs who have heeded the call.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: May mga nakapag-submit naman po ng savings nila in accordance sa NBC 602. And 603, Your Honor, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Mr. Chair, may isa pa rin po tayong nakuhang concern from SUCs na meron po silang mga MOOEs requested for extension campuses na hindi po nag-agrant.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And dahil po doon napapwersang kumuha ng piece of the pie sa MOOE ng main campuses para po mapondohan lang yung operations ng extension campuses. We can discuss this po. Would the good secretary be amenable to a dialogue or a discussion para po ma-insure na hindi po, kung mangyari ito para po pondo and continuous yung operations ng lahat ng SUCs natin?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: We fully recognize that, Your Honor, Mr. Chair, in fact, we're maintaining an inventory of all recent legislations as well,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: institutionalizing satellite campuses or annexes so that this can be factored in in our programming,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: but also cognizant of available resources din po sa ating mga SUCs, kabilang na nga rin po itong

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: latest release natin in settling our arrears for free higher education. But we'd be happy to sit

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: with Your Honor to strategize how we'll be able to

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: settle

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: ito pong ating mga funding requirements for satellite units and extension campuses.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Happy to hear that, Secretary, lalo na po, as it stands, may mga kawawa po talagang legislated extension campuses dahil wala pong pondo. Next

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: question ko po ay on confidential and intelligence funds.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: According to—during our turnover, you mentioned po na yung mga ahensya lang pong legally authorized ang merong CIF this 2027. Can I ask, ano pong mga ahensya ang legally authorized to have CIF? Is there a list that DBM has?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Mr. Chair, Your Honor, the following po are the agencies with confidential expenses in the proposed 2027 NEP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Can

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: I ask, Mr. Chair, so yan po ay for 2027, every year po ba that changes according to which agency requests for confidential funds?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Not necessarily, Your Honor. In fact, for 2027, we

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: reverted to the

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: same agencies na meron pong confidential and intelligence funds under the 2026 NEP. So

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: these are practically same

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: agencies when we refer to the NEP. Although the levels are lower

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: than the 2026 GAA, Your Honor, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So there's no one list? Na ito lang pong pwedeng mga ahensya may CIF, yung

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: iba hindi?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Ito po yung list, Your Honor, If that is what we refer to as the one list, then these are the agencies who are legally authorized and historically provided for with confidential and intelligence funds.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: in the GAA, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Should I mention the agencies?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Yes, if you could, Secretary.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: So we start with

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: the confidential funds.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: For confidential funds, Your Honor: the Office of the President; DENR-OSEC;

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: DOF-BOC;

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: DOF-BIR;

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: DILG-OSEC;

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: DOJ-OSEC;

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: [unclear agency name];

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Bureau of Immigration, DOJ NBI,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: DOJ Office

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: of the Solicitor General,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: DND OSEC,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: DSWD OSEC,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: DOTR Office of Transportation Security, the

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Anti-Money Laundering Council,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Games and Amusement Board,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: National Intelligence Coordinating Agency, National Security Council,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: OPAPRU, PIDEA,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: COA, the Ombudsman, Commission on Human Rights. Basically, your honor, those

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: with mandate in conduct of surveillance activities, counterintelligence, and investigation.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: For intelligence funds, your honor,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: it's limited to the Office of the President, the

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Philippine National Police,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: the

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: DND OSEC,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: the Armed Forces of the Philippines, the

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Philippine Coast Guard and NICA, Your Honor, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So kung may ahensya po bang gustong may confidential activities or gustong maipa confidential expenses, they have to ask DBM?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Does DBM have the power to say, sige, pwede, and then ilagay natin sa budget?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Any request for the grant of confidential expenses, your honor, will have to be... will be evaluated based on their mandate.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: If the agency has the mandate in conducting

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: surveillance

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: and counter-surveillance activities, yun lamang po yung magiging basis

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: natin sa pag-propose ng

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: confidential expenses. But then again, your honor, Mr. Chair, in the 2027 budget,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: nanatili po yung same list ng mga agencies na

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: meron pong confidential and intelligence funds.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And wala po ang Department of Education and OVP. Dito sa list na ito.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: We confirm, your honor, wala po ang Department of Education and Office of the Vice President sa

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: listahan po ng

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: mayroong confidential and intelligence funds for 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Or historically, have they never been in the list?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Based on this table, your honor, Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: there was one year kung saan po nagkaroon po ng confidential

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: fund ang

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Office of the Vice President and DepEd. And that was in... In 2023,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: your honor, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: if they request again, maaaring i

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: -evaluate pa rin ang DBM. So, I guess, this is of... I'm asking this dahil mataas po yung public interest dito. Currently, there's concurrent processes

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: in the Senate, tinitignan yung mandato ng DepEd and OVP to actually maghawak ng confidential and intelligence funds. It's been found that...

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: It was used on tree planting activities, parties, other events. So, actually, my question would

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: like to go a little bit in detail if the Chair will allow me.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Last question, Congresswoman Rennie. Pwede pa naman next round.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Thank you. Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: can the DBM check the physical and

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: financial plan? Ito po ay annex sa lahat ng mga agencies na nag-request at mag-share ng kanilang mga confidential expenses.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Can the DBM check and maybe deny yung request for confidential expenses based on the physical and financial plan kung na-check nila na hindi pala

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: in line sa mandate nila?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Well, sa umpisa pa lang po kasi, your honor, Mr. Chair, yun pong pagkakaroon ng confidential and intelligence funds, babalik po muli tayo dun sa mandate. Pagdating po dun sa physical and financial plan,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: ang DBM po, nire-review po natin yan. But our... Our

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: visibility is also limited kasi nga po yung detalye siyempre po nung paggagamitan actually ay

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: confidential as well. So, yun po yung nagiging bahagi natin sa evaluation.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Yun pong actual na pinagagamitan po, doon na po pumapasok yung role po ng COA sa pag-audit kung saan actually dinala yung confidential and intelligence funds ng mga ahensya. Mr.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Chair, I make this manifestation because

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: ayaw

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: nating maulit yung nangyayari ngayon. Na ito... It took spending and then pagbubut-but ng COA and then years after, makikita kung gaano kadami yung anomalies bago makita na

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: hindi pala tama, kailangan ibalik sa kaban ng bayan yung maling nagasta. So, if sa level pa lang po ng DBM, ay kaya na po pala siyang ma-check, may some level of discretion, may some level of

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: accountability

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: at that level, kaya na pong mangyari. We'd like to... We'd like to see kung pwedeng mas i-exercise ng DBM yun. And I'm asking this also dahil in 2018, nagkaroon po ng... or 2017, nagkaroon po ng sudden increase yung confidential expenses ng Office of the President. From 2016, 500 million, naging 2.5 billion na po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: And up

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: until now, we don't have transparent reasons kung bakit, except noong 2017, may limang agencies and purposes na dinescribe. Kung saan po pwedeng pumunta tong 2.5 billion na ito. So may I ask, last question, Mr. Chair, this 2.5 billion pesos na ganito kalaki na confidential expenses ng Office of the President, may kaalaman po ba yung DBM kung saan po ito napupunta? Mayroon pong five purposes na nilista before.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Presidential

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Anti-Organized Crime Commission, Philippine Center on Transnational Crime,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: etc. Pero hindi rin po detalyado. Walang specific budget allocation. Okay,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: so that will be the last question, Congresswoman Rene.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Maraming salamat. Secretary Kim,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: please

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: reply.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Your Honor, as to evaluating, we would continue evaluating any request. In fact,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: for 2027, mayroon po kaming mga na-receive na request for confidential funds.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: But upon evaluation, nakita po namin na po pwede namang hindi confidential yung nature ng expenses. At doon na lang po namin

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: probably i-dadagdag. Instead of it being a confidential. So bahagi po yun nung ating evaluation.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: As to the details kung saan po yung actual na paggamitan ng

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: confidential and intelligence funds, considering the nature of these funds, Your Honor,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: nandun lang po kami sa overall program or overall strategies kung saan po ito maaaring mapunta. Consistent din po doon sa joint circular that is issued on how intelligence and confidential funds are authorized to be disbursed. Your Honor, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Thank you. Thank you, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Thank you very much, Congresswoman Renee. And thank you very much,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Secretary Kim.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: That ends our first round.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: And we will proceed immediately to

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: our second round. At dito po sa second round, wala na pong majority-minority independent. Kung

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: sino po yung unang nag-register,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: sila po yung unang

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: tatawagin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: So, may

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: we call on

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Representative Antonio Tinio to

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: begin our second round.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Thank you, Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Chair, babalikan ko yung pera, personal economic relief allowance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kanina, tama po ba ang intindi ko? Sabi ni Secretary

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kim,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ay may

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: study ngayon and

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: then they will hopefully

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: napako.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Of course,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ang tanong kagad dyan ay magkano?

segments.text: Kung increase, magkano? At may budget ba yan sa pinropose nyo?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Mr. Chair, Your Honor, actually yun po yung bahagi ng pag-aaral. Kung magkano po yung maire-recommendang increase.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: At yung pangalawa pong factor din is hopefully,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay. Kaya ako po tinatanong yan kasi nga 55 billion pesos ang nasa MPBF. Isang lump sum po yan.

segments.text: And earlier, in my interpretation earlier, sinabi ko historically, yung

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio

segments.text: Binabawasan to make room for congressional insertion. So, kaya gusto ko pong i-diin, Mr. Chair, na malinaw na, no, ang plano dito sa

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: 55 billion ay

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: pang pondo

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: sa pera

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ng

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: mga government employees. So, dapat hindi na ito galawin at bawasan ng

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: kongreso.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, kung para

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: magkaroon lang tayo ng idea, Mr. Chair,

segments.text: pera, yung

segments.text: 2,000 maging 3,000, magkano ang kailangan?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Kung, Mr. Chair, Your Honor, based on our estimate, kung 1,000 ang i-increase po ng pera, representing 50% increase,

segments.text: So, 24 billion pesos, 55 billion ang MPBF.

segments.text: So,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: maximum, kaya ng 2,000.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Tama po ba?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Although, Your Honor, we have to note as well that yung pong Miscellaneous Personnel Benefits Fund ay bukod po doon, ay may iba pa pong mga pinaggamitan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: We understand.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Nandito rin po yung performance-based bonus.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Opo. Yun pong ating funding for vacancies in the executive branch at kung meron man pong

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: mga changes in organizational staffing po ng ating mga government agencies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Noted. Of course po. Ang sinasabi lang natin, it can accommodate up to 2,000.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: In other words, a doubling of the

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: current pera.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: I-note ko lang po, yung subsistence allowance ng militar,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: from 150 a day, ginawa niyong 350 a day. That's more than double.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Tama po ba? At magkano ang nakalaang pondo doon?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Actually, Your Honor, Mr. Chair, yun pong pondo for the adjusted subsistence allowance ng ating military and uniformed personnel,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: dahil ito po ay nakafix na, alinsunod po doon sa EO, nasa respective agency budgets na po ito nakalodge.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Ang total subsistence allowance po for our MUPs for 2027 is

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: about 74

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: billion na nakadistribute na po, Your Honor, Mr. Chair, sa kanikanyang

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: agency-specific budgets.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, ang pinupunto ko lang ay ganong kalaki po ang nilaan for the increase in subsistence allowance, bali

segments.text: second

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: year na po ito. Tama ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, kailangan na pong ihabol natin yung sa Sibilyan, which is pera.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, wala na pong galawan. Yun lang sinasabi, babantayan na po natin ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Next question ko po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: marami akong gustong itanong, pero nabanggit

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: yung confidential and intelligence funds.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Una po, malinaw sa confidential and intelligence. Intelligence funds, 10

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: .8 billion total ang nasa budget. Tama po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At 4.56 billion nito,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: o halos

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: kalahati, ay nasa Office of the President.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: At

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: yung 4.56 billion na confidential and intelligence funds ng Office of the President constitutes

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: 44.9% of the Office of the President's budget. Tama po ba? No?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sumusunod ba yan sa, sabi nga, sound

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: principles of budgeting na

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ang

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: halos kalahati ng kanyang budget, ng agency budget, ay confidential and intelligence funds?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Your Honor, Mr. Chair, ito pong confidential and intelligence funds ng Office of the President has been at that level

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: since—almost at that level since 2020. At ito po ay bahagi ng functions ng ating Pangulo bilang Commander-in-Chief ng ating Armed Forces, Your Honor, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sinagot, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ang

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: tanong ko po ay, alinsunod ba sa mga prinsipyo ng,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: you know, good governance ng isang ahensya,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: halos

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: kalahati ng kanyang budget,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: confidential, secret, hindi transparent?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Your Honor,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Dahil ang opisina po ng Pangulo ay may mandato, kaya po yung

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: provision niya for confidential and intelligence funds ay

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: tingin po natin na ay naaayon, kaya po kasama po yan sa ating National Expenditure Program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sinabi niyo 2020 lang nangyari yan. So historically hindi po ganyan. Abnormal po ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So yun ang pinapoint out natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Now,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: tanong ko po, yung confidential and intelligence funds,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: item po ba yan?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Is that a line item in the budget?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Definition of item is

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: activity

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: or project, di ba?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Yun po, Your Honor, Mr. Chair, yun pong

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: confidential expenses at intelligence expenses ay mga object of expenditure.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: So may katapat po itong mga...

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: ...PAP.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Kaya po dapat ito ay directly connected

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: sa mandato po ng opisina dahil doon po nakapailalim sa PAP na yun,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: yun pong object of expenditure na confidential expenses at intelligence expenses.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So in short, hindi siya item?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Tama, object of expenditure, di ba?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Object of expenditure po siya, Your Honor, Mr. Chair, pero bahagi po siya ng isang PAP at yun po yung item of expenditure.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay, hindi. Kaya nga... Actually, in the budget, the actual term that appears is confidential and intelligence expenses, di

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Pero walang hiwalay na item na confidential and intelligence funds.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: There's a difference. And why do I raise this? Gusto ko po i-raise ito para sa committee rin at para sa

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: DBM,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang termino talaga is confidential and intelligence expenses. However, pinag-ahalo...

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: And kahit sa inyong joint circular, nakalagay d'yon, confidential and intelligence funds.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Making it appear as if

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: hiwalay na pondo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: parang stand-alone item ang confidential and intelligence funds.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Now, why am I insisting on this distinction?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kasi may implication po, pag tinrato n'yong parang item,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ang item po

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: pwedeng i-augment from savings. And

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: in fact,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: your guidelines... Allow for that. Di ba? Yung intelligence fund pwedeng i-augment from savings. Tama, mali.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Okay, that will be the last question.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Continue.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Thank you very much. Kim, please reply.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Your Honor, Mr. Chair, since yun nga pong intelligence or confidential expenses ay object of expenditure,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: yun pong eligible for augmentation, use of savings, is yung PAP.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Yung PAP po yung eligible. Yung PAP po yung eligible for augmentation, but subject still to compliance po with the requisites under the general provision and the approvals

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: provided for under the GAA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Okay,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: maraming salamat. Pwedeng i-augment, pero yung authorization for confidential expenses,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: hindi

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: pwedeng i-augment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Di ba? At hindi pwedeng gawin ng

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: lagpasan

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ng executive.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Tama ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Thank you, Sec. Tino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: [unclear], time is up po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ako lang po ang sinasabi ko. May mali po

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: kahit sa patakaran ng

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: DBM at sa joint circular ng DBM na tinatrato bilang parang hiwalay na pondo o item

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: ang confidential and intelligence funds and

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: the

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: rules themselves allow for augmentation from savings na parang item.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: may mga, I mean, limited ang oras ko. Pero may marami pong mga implikasyon nito na kailangang wastoin po ito. They are expenses. They are not items. They cannot be augmented from savings, among others.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Hindi po ba? Can I get a response from?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Mali ito at dapat wastoin na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Dahil iyan ang inaabuso.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Yes, continue. Maybe a quick response from Sec. Kim. Tapos kung gusto ninyo, an expanded response, maybe in writing. Submit to the committee and we will give a copy to—

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Continue.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Yun pong, ang ino-augment naman po talaga as in any case, hindi lang po yung

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: confidential and intelligence na line item. Hindi po yung line item.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Yun pong PAP,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: yun pong ino-augment natin. If DIMP deficient at kailangan po talagang i-augment. Yun pong confidential expenses and

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: intelligence expenses are object of expenditure, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Okay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Thank you very much. Tapos paki-expound na lang in writing para lahat ng details, masagot sa tanong ni Congressman Tinio.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: We will submit, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Thank you very much. So next is—

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Congressman Edgar Erice still here?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Parang wala na?

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Okay. So we will proceed to the next

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: representative.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: We call on Congressman Elijah San Fernando.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Please proceed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. Salamat po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Secretary Balisacan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: kanina po natapos tayo doon sa usapin ng mga trabaho.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Meron po kayong prinesent kanina at ito binabanggit nyo pa po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: kanina pa, na

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: merong mga persistent constraints kung bakit hindi tayo makapaglikha ng mga industriya, ng

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: mga quality jobs, better paying jobs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: And some of these factors, alimbawa itong sa economic and market factors, alimbawa high energy cost,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Alam niyo, may pwede naman po tayong gawin agad dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Halimbawa, we can remove,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: or if not, reduce value-added tax on electricity.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So would you agree with me dito, Secretary Balisakan?

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: Yes, of course, there are things that you can do in the short term, in the near term,

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: Mr.

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: Chair.

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: And of course, taxes could be one. But again, tax

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: issues are

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: More complex than that, because

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: there are broader concerns that we have to also take into account.

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: And

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: so, for example, given the fiscal

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: space

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: use

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: and the

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: so much need for other development investments, you really have to identify a

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: replacement for those revenues that will be sacrificed as a result. So, it's easy to remove, but

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: we have to be mindful of the consequences

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: for other sectors and other agencies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. Salamat po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So, punta po sa Department of Finance. Is it the position of Department of Finance to oppose any discussion

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: about the removal or reduction of value-added tax on electricity?

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: In general, the position of the Department of Finance is that everything is fungible.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: If you want to remove VAT

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: from

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: electricity, but

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: you can show another

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: revenue source of taxes,

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: we're neutral. But the

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: Department of Finance would naturally be opposed to the removal of any tax

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: without a replacement

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: tax.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: categorical position, Secretary Go?

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: Yeah, our categorical position is we are not opposed to the removal of any tax as long as there is a replacement revenue source.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So, we can do something about this, the reduction po ng energy cost. Isa rin po sa example dito sa mga factors kung bakit hindi pumapasok yung mga, hindi tayo nakakapagbuo ng industriya,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: itong fragmented coordination.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando

segments.text: Kung minsan, top-heavy na po. So

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: just like what we did with CreateMore,

segments.text: ni-rationalize natin yung fiscal and non-fiscal incentives. Ginawa nating one-size-fits-all para rationalize. But the world doesn't work that way. Pero pinasa pa rin natin, again, some of the recommendations of the investment promotion agencies na sila yung frontliner pagdating sa pag-attract ng investment. So I'd like to ask, how did it work for us, ito pong CreateMore?

segments.text: Mr. Chair, I actually want to,

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: if I may rephrase,

segments.text: I'm

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: The problem was created by Create.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: So we created CreateMore.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: So CreateMore solved the problems of Create.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: Because Create centralized the approval among all the investment promotion agencies into the Fiscal Incentives Review Board.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: In CreateMore, we devolved it again.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: So CreateMore solved the problems of Create.

segments.text: Devolved up to a certain limit po.

segments.text: Yes, that's right.

segments.text: Pero still,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia

segments.text: Yes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Plus yung incentives,

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: one-size-fits-all pa rin.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: No, no. If I may correct that also as well, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Albert S. Garcia
segments.text: Yes, please.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: The incentives in Create, the investor has a choice. He can avail of the Special Corporate Income Tax, the

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: so-called SCIT or 5% of gross income earned.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: Or he can avail of the Enhanced Deduction Regime,

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: the EDD.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: So it's not a one-size-fits-all. The investor can actually choose.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: Secondly also, the

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: investments are also controlled. Customizable, if your investment is over 50 billion pesos,

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: you can customize it,

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: which we did with Samsung. When

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: Samsung applied

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: for an investment of a 50 billion multi-layer ceramic capacitor factory in Laguna,

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: we approved a customized

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: package for him because his investment was over 50 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: So it's not one-size-fits-all. I really think that Create more solved the problems of Create.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: to 95% of all

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: applications that go through them. And only 5% to 10% go up.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: So whoever said that,

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: I will challenge him in front of you anytime, any day.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: Got registered.

segments.text: Relative to our neighbors in the ASEAN.

segments.text: So it jumped to 1.9 trillion. But yes, I will accept that we're
