segments.text: Next to interpellate for the second round, Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand Hernandez.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: This is my first round, Madam Chair. Thank

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: To DOF. Sorry, Sec.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Madali

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: lang 'to.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: The Chair of Ways and Means and I filed

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: a bill for

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: the removal of VAT on system loss.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: And I just feel, based on discussion, that

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: we don't need a legislation.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: I

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: totally agree with your

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: position that when you ask for a removal of, let's

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: say, VAT, you have to identify another source when it is legitimately imposed.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: However,

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: dun sa systems loss kasi, I'll just read this, Sec.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: No consumption, no

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: VAT.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Electricity loss before it reaches the consumer should not be treated as the same manner as electricity actually delivered and consumed.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Removing VAT on system loss, therefore, aligns the

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: tax treatment with the consumption-based character of VAT and

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: prevents consumer from paying a tax on electricity never

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: actually used.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: So,

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: nag-impose tayo ng VAT on

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: consumption.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Ito kasi, they're

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: paying already the system loss.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Kumbaga,

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: pinasa na yung sa system loss sa consumer, ninagdagan pa ng VAT na

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: hindi naman dapat i-impose because it's not consumption.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: So, this is different from VAT on electricity, only on the

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: system loss. So, what is the position now of

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: DOF and BIR? Kasi, nakikita namin,

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: You can come up with your

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: own rules and regulation. And you've cited several times, na ito yung mga VAT exempt.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: And it covers even previous imposition and then

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: later on,

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: sinasabi nyo na VAT exempt to. So,

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: what we're asking

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: is that I

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: don't think we need the legislation. All we need is new,

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: probably rules and regulation

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: exempting VAT on system loss.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: Thank you very much, Madam Chair. Your Honor, thank you very much. It's a point well taken. With

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: your permission, I will ask our BIR Commissioner, Charlie Mendoza, to respond.

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: Yes.

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: Madam Chair, tama po iyon. Recently, we issued a revenue memorandum circular

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: exempting some

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: charges from VAT.

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: Iyan po ay iyong Green Energy Auction Allowance at iyong Lifeline Subsidy. We

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: issued a revenue memorandum circular categorically stating that

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: they should not be subject to VAT

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: because these are clearly mandated pass-

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: through charges.

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: So, the current problem po kasi with system loss charge is

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: that it is bundled

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: with the gross sales

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: of the companies,

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: of the distributor.

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: So, it becomes part of the gross sale and therefore, it forms part of the tax base of the VAT base. That is why it is currently being subject to VAT.

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: But we are closely working with ERC on this, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: Nag-uusap po kami.

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: At

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: tinitingnan po namin kung paano natin mare-resolve itong concern na ito.

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: In fact, as far as I know, they have a draft

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: regulation addressing

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: this.

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: At ang pagkakaalam ko po is it will go

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: through a public consultation next

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: week. And then, titingnan po namin doon

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: based doon sa regulation na ilalabas ng ERC.

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: Pero maliwanag naman po ang posisyon ng BIR dyan kung

segments.speaker: BIR Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza
segments.text: iyan po ay hindi part ng gross sales, kung iyan po ay mandated pass-through charge lang, iyan po ay hindi dapat ma-subject sa VAT.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: So, Sek, this is important, no? Kasi para

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: malaman ng taong bayan,

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: meron naman pwedeng gawin na hindi na kailangan ng legislation.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: And they've been asking for this. The

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: President mentioned this during SONA na

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: merong solusyon na hindi na kailangan tumagal.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: All it takes is for BIR at ERC to sit down and

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: come up with a new

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: list or items that are chargeable and

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: removing VAT.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Kasi in system loss, meron pang...

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Technical and non-technical. And there's no issue on the non-technical. But

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: as far as VAT, whether it's technical or non-technical, dapat talaga hindi na ma-impose yung VAT.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: Your Honor, your points are very well taken. I think what our

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: BIR Commissioner mentioned is that there is light at the end of the tunnel, but

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: there needs to be certain conditions that need to be satisfied.

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: We enumerated two. But

segments.speaker: DOF Secretary Frederick D. Go
segments.text: I think the good news is there is light at the end of the tunnel on this one, I think. So

segments.text: we probably,

segments.text: if the ERC ever comes in front of your

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Commissioner

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: and ERC and they're working on it. And I hope that it can be resolved soon para sa taong bayan.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: baka napaka-detrimental sa taong bayan. So what's the position of DOF on this?

segments.text: Congress

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Thank you, Chair. Just to get back also on free higher education, Madam Chair, this representation would like to share

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: its appreciation na may attention finally doon sa pag-disburse at paglabas ng pondo para po sa free higher education deficiency. And the Secretary made mention of their updated formula in relation sa pag

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: -calculate ano yung SUC budget. May this representation be furnished a copy of how the DBM now calculates the budget?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Okay. And just a practical question po, Madam Chair. Section 4 po kasi provides that the basis should be the projected number of enrollees for each academic year. Pero mukhang nag-share po ng DBM. Parang actual number of enrollees for the

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: average of three years. Paano po i-reconcile ng DBM yun?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Your honor, Madam Chair, that is the reason why we used some proxy indicator to approximate the probable increase because historically,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: the

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: reason why there were arrears because the old enrollment figures were used.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: But this time, we used the three

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: -year estimate. So, the average growth of the enrollment so that we

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: can approximate the level of increase for 2027. As for any variance that may arise,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: even if we have already applied this average growth rate,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: that is something that will have to be calculated with CHED and UNIFA so that we can

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: identify the amount and the possible corresponding source, your honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Thank you po, Madam Chair. And syempre, tuloy-tuloyin namang BWM. Pagkabantayan ng representasyong ito yung

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: yung pagkakaroon ng libre legalidad abot kamay na edukasyon para sa kabataan.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Just to add as well, your honor, Madam Chair, in relation to the almost 10 billion that we have released, the

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: release actually has a small portion or small allowance that will allow CHED

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: to entertain possible appeals from SUCs in case there will be some discrepancies. In terms of the enrollment being claimed. So that can be

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: handled very well by CHED. And we maintain close coordination, your honor, to

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: fully settle our FHE careers to our SUCs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair. Last na lang po on confidential funds. Dahil may nirelease lang din po today, or a few days ago na article yung Rappler, detailing how even at the local government level,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: meron ding increases in... confidential funds na nire-report ang mga LGUs. Is there an explanation for this? Bakit po dumadami yung mga pondong nire-request that confidentially ginagamit? Ayun nga po, bumabalik tayo doon sa prinsipyo na ideally, transparent yung mekanismo ng pag-report ng spending ng public funds, pero dumadami yung ganitong instances.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Madam

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Chair, your honor, number one. May time po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Thank you.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: On the confidential funds of LGUs, number one, meron pong

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: guidelines na sinusunod ang ating mga local government units in the preparation of the respective

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: LGU budgets. At in fact,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: meron pong limitation din po ang pagkakaroon ng confidential funds sa ating mga local government units dahil

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: patid po natin that they also perform peace and order mandate.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: So meron po tayong issued na joint... Kabilang po ito doon sa issued joint circular on

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: the limitation and use of confidential funds, kabilang po yung proper documentation na

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: necessary to support the same. At sa atin pong mga local government units,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: kailangan pong ma-aprubahan ng

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: kanilang respective local

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: peace and order council, number one.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Dapat po may covering local peace and order council approval, yung proposed allocation. Ngayon din, dahil ito po ay appropriation sa level ng... Dapat din po itong ma-aprubahan ng kanilang mga respective sanggunian, your honor, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So does DBM look at these resolutions?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Meron po bang nakikitang trends? Bakit po ba dumadagdag yung spending? And sa dulo po ba nito, ano po bang pwedeng magawa pa ng DBM to ensure na

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: nagagamit sa tama, hindi nahulog sa maling paggasta ang confidential funds?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Number one po, your honor, Madam Chair, at the level of the DBM, ang dumarating po sa amin for review and approval ng mga LGU budgets, ay yun pong para sa mga

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: provinces and highly urbanized cities. Dahil po yung iba pong level under the local government code,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: meron pong iba't-ibang nagre-review. So for DBM,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: we review and approve the budgets of provinces and highly

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: urbanized city at tinitingnan po natin sa ating pag-review yung

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: kanila pong compliance sa iba't-ibang paratong budget. So yung parameters on local budgets, kapilang na

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: po dyan yung limitation on the allocation for

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: confidential fund. As to the utilization,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: your honor, we fully submit that it is within, nandoon na nga po sa Joint Circular,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: yun po kasing report ng actual na paggamit ng confidential fund ay hindi

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: po sa DBM actually sinasubmit.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: It's being submitted to the Commission on Audit for their

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: post-audit and determination whether the same is actually used in accordance. With the

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: approved peace and order plan endorsed by the respective local peace and order councils of their LGUs, your honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: to clarify,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: siyempre labas na yung post

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: -allocation dahil ang COA po ang gumagawa. Pero prior po or during sa pag-submit po ng budget, maaari po bang tignan ng DBM at mag-disapprove ng

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: plan ng paggasta kung may na-flag?

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Your honor, Madam Chair, sa review po kasi ng mga regional offices ng DBM ng budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: To clarify po, Madam Chair, we're also including din sana yung national government agencies, NGAs, sana, and hindi lang po LGUs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: In your answer, supposedly, Secretary.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Your honor, Madam Chair, in evaluating, sorry po if I have to differentiate kasi magkaiba po kasi yung proseso. For the local government units, our regional offices that reviews local government units' budgets,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: primarily, ang tinitingnan po dito, well, number one, if it does not exceed the ceiling provided for under existing

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: guidelines, and if these are properly supported

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: by the requisite

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: mentioned documents dun po sa ating joint circular. So one po yung ceiling, pangalawa po yung

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: presence ng resolution endorsement ng

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: local peace and order council, gayon din po

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: yung supporting certification

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: from the PNP chief regarding the peace and order situation, that actually necessitates yung

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: pangangailangan po sa confidential fund ng isang LGU.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: So dun po sa level na yun pumapasok yung role ng DBM.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Pagdating po sa national government agency, again, similarly,

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: mandato po ng ahensya yung una nating tinitingnan, and as to amount, we have practically limited yung amount po ng confidential and intelligence funds to

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: the NEP level, at hindi po tayo halos nagbigay or nag-entertain ng any request for increase or new confidential funds, na civilian agencies na lalo na po kung wala pong mandato na

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: magsagawa ng intelligence, counterintelligence, or security operations, Your Honor. So

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Chair, ang naririnig ko po ba ay, correct me if I'm wrong, yes, may power ang DBM na gawin yun. Kung malabas po sa mandato, maaari niyang i-disprove yung

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: sinubmit na budget request, or para ma-include po sa national budget,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: yung confidential expenses na gustong gamitin, gastahin.

segments.speaker: Acting DBM Secretary Kim Robert C. De Leon
segments.text: Yes, Your Honor. Okay,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: thank you Madam Chair. My

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: next question po would be to DepDev,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: in

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: relation po sa kanyang presentation

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: po

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: nila earlier.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: This

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: was in the presentation earlier kung saan, taking off from the points of Representative Eli San Fernando, nakita po na the

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: economy remains heavily

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: reliant on consumption and services, constraining faster, more durable, and inclusive growth.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Na-mention din po ni PBBM sa kanyang SONA that

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: there will be a product of the, may product of a 23-member strong and US-led PAC-SILICA initiative, which

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: will accelerate industrial competitiveness and revitalize our economy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: So ang tanong po natin ng representation na ito, is

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: PAC-SILICA part of the industrial growth strategy, the broadening of sources of growth? Now,

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: if PAC-SILICA will involve the

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: industries like manufacturing of

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: say semiconductors, electronics, high-value manufacturing,

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: then indeed that's what would

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: be beneficial and be supportive of our industrialization.

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: But then again, recall that, as shared

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: by our colleagues earlier is

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: that this is still

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: an evolving

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: concept, no?

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: Wala pa namang mga specific industries

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: na nandun or companies,

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: no?

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: But clearly,

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: if it's about

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: setting up an industrial hub that

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: will create jobs,

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: that will bring in the kind of technologies that will increase higher value or adding value to our local production,

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: then that's what I meant or could be supportive of what I suggested earlier that we need to diversify the sources of growth.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Chair, according to PBBM-SAête it

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: will be in part the Luzon Economic Corridor and it will be an advanceduary manufacturing and logistics center in the global AI and technology value chain. So I'm asking these questions because just yesterday, the

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: U.S. State Department recognized a leak of internal documents, including a draft letter to be addressed to dozens of countries. And it says that countries must pick sides in the artificial intelligence race between the U.S.-led Paxilica and China. Sabi ng draft, signature of the Paxilica declaration is not merely a membership subscription, but commitment, and that U.S. hopes to limit China's access to resources needed to develop increasingly sophisticated AI to be used for military and economic dominance. Madam Chair, ang tanong ko po, are

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: we signing up to be a pawn in an AI development race by competing superpowers? Is that what's at play here,

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: or is it quote-unquote development?

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: What we are pushing is development for the Philippines.

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: And whether it is that

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: is China or that's the U.S. or that's Europe or that's U.K. for so long as they

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: come in and that

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: is consistent with our interest and

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: meeting our objectives. So it is, I

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: define it as creating opportunities for Filipinos.

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: Then those kind of... Those kind of investment would be encouraged. So

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: we look at it as a part of our strategy

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: to industrialize the country.

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: And

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: the bottom line is they improve the mix of our industries

segments.speaker: DEPDev Secretary Arsenio M. Balisacan
segments.text: so that we are able to provide high quality jobs. For Filipinos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Madam Chair, a final manifestation perhaps in response to the answer of our good Secretary. I have to ask, development for whom? Development at what cost?

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: Because

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: sa dulo po nito, mukhang kung the United States who leads this initiative will

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: be making this kind of ultimatum, pick a side. And sa

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: dulo din nito, ang pagtatayo ng hub ay marami pa pong questions kung sino pa ang magbe-bear ng cost na ito—land-wise, environmental-wise, electricity

segments.speaker: Rep. Renee Louise M. Co
segments.text: -wise, water-wise, even the rights of indigenous peoples kung paano po ito marirespeto. These are questions and kailangan pong itimbang kung kaya at gusto ba natin at makakaambag po ba sa develop natin or development for others yung pagsama natin sa Paxilica. That's all, Madam Chair.
